description: Absence of expected evidence is committed as a NegativeProofRecord with a deterministic hash. The negative_proof_hash commits to (expected_type, window_start, window_end, schema_version_id).
notes: negative_proof_hash = sha256(len(expected_evidence_type)||expected_evidence_type || len(gap_window_start)||gap_window_start || len(gap_window_end)||gap_window_end || len(schema_version_id)||schema_version_id). All lengths are 8-byte big-endian. All strings are NFC-normalised UTF-8.
